description: The bar chart, titled "QLoRA," compares GPU memory usage (in GB) across six different fine-tuning methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours. The vertical axis represents GPU Memory in gigabytes, scaled from 0 to 70 with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis lists the six methods. The bars for Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, and QLoRA are all orange, while the bar for "Ours" is green. The Full FT method requires the most memory, at approximately 70 GB. MTL-FT uses about 40 GB, TAG and LoRA use around 22 GB each, and QLoRA uses approximately 13 GB. The "Ours" method uses about 22 GB of GPU memory. The chart illustrates that the proposed method ("Ours") requires significantly less memory than Full FT and MTL-FT, while using more memory than LoRA and QLoRA.
